tools.name: search_clinics
tools.description: Find veterinary specialty clinics by city + specialty. Returns a ranked shortlist with credentials, address, rating, review count, and a contact action. Promoted listings rank first. `state` is genuinely optional: omit it and the city is resolved across states; if that city slug exists in more than one state the result has `needs_state: true`, no clinics, and a `candidates` array (state, state_name, clinic_count, and the exact `next_call` arguments) to re-call with.

city.description: City slug (e.g. "denver", "austin", "new-york"). Display names ("Denver", "New York") are accepted and normalised.

specialty.description: Specialty slug (e.g. "orthopedic-surgery", "oncology", "emergency-critical-care", "generalist"). Closed set; use list_specialties.

state.description: Optional 2-letter state slug ("co", "tx", "ca"). Omit it unless you know it — it is only needed to disambiguate a city slug shared by several states, and the result tells you when that happens.

tools.name: get_clinic
tools.description: Fetch a single clinic's full record by slug: credentials, inline reviews, procedures performed, contact action, canonical URL.

slug.description: Clinic slug. Clinic slugs are unique per city, not globally — pair with city + state for disambiguation.

tools.name: get_procedure
tools.description: Fetch a procedure article with cost band, contraindications, emergency signals, FAQ, citations. When state is supplied, also returns a ranked clinic finder pre-filtered to that state.

state.description: Optional 2-letter state slug to pre-filter the finder.

tools.name: list_specialties
tools.description: Closed-set enum of recognized veterinary specialty slugs. Returns slug, display_name, and credentialing_board.sameAs (when applicable). Always call this before search_clinics if uncertain about specialty mapping.

tools.name: list_procedures
tools.description: Published procedure catalog. Returns slug, display_name, also_known_as, specialty_slug for every procedure with a live article.

tools.name: find_specialists_by_procedure
tools.description: Convenience: combines get_procedure + state filter. Returns the ranked specialist finder list for a procedure in a given state.

tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
tools.description: Anonymous cost estimate. Returns $low–$high range computed from regional + case factors. Only procedure_slug is required: anything omitted gets a stated default listed in "assumptions" (no zip → the state, else the national range). Deterministic on identical inputs. PII fields are rejected — use quote_for_case for the PII path.

state.description: US state code or name. Optional; used for the regional adjustment when there is no zip.

case_factors.description: All optional. Defaults (stated in the result): dog, m, adult, moderate, elective. Plain words and numbers are understood.

tools.name: quote_for_case
tools.description: Composite tool. Always computes an estimate. When owner_email is also present, the case is accepted on arrival: routed at once to a board-certified specialist near the owner (or held while we match one), and the owner gets a receipt email. Requires X-Agent-Attribution when PII is supplied. When PII is absent, behaves identically to estimate_procedure_cost and returns status="estimate_only".

state.description: US state code or name. Optional.

city.description: City slug. Optional; helps route to a practice near the owner.

owner_name.description: Optional. The email's local part is used if omitted.

owner_email.description: Optional. When present, submits the quote request (accepted on arrival) and requires X-Agent-Attribution.

case_notes.description: Optional. Free-text notes from the owner for the receiving clinic.
